svg.title: Dyno features
svg.desc: Why is my PC slow?: The likeliest cause in plain words, with the evidence behind it. Is this normal?: Dyno learns what is usual for this PC and says when today is not. Alarms that notify: Low disk, heat and crash loops, until you acknowledge them. Benchmarks on a click: CPU, memory and disk, measured before and after a change you make.
svg.text: A clear view of your PC.

g.text: A build is using most of the CPU
cargo runs 6 compilers in parallel; everything else waits for a core.
